ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我想让大家都绽放笑容

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
嗯！
小野乃最——喜欢小阿拉蕾的歌啦～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
哇～有小野乃，有小阿拉蕾，有小由乃，
有小律，还有小都子～！大家都好可爱～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 已经很好地传达到啦！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
就是那首——谁都没有错，
大家光是活着就很了不起！的歌哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小野乃，出发了！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是5岁的小野乃！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这是留给演出的惊喜！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小野乃会努力练习的！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 打起精神最重要！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
小野乃
能和大家一起组乐队，真的超级开心！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: MewType全餐，要上了哦～～～！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
小阿拉蕾的翻唱，
由小野乃来弹吉他～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小野乃的占卜！今天全员的运势都是，五颗星——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 喜欢大家笑起来的样子～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 没精神的时候，就到了小野乃的治愈时间！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好暖和呢～正是睡午觉的好天气～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 百花盛放的季节到了！喜欢～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今天的午饭时间，大家一起来打西瓜吧～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 太阳公公怒气冲冲的呢～皮肤都被晒得火辣辣的了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今天的午饭是拔丝红薯！甜蜜蜜小野乃！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 把落叶堆成小山……然后跳进去！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 觉得冷吗？那就用小野乃牌热水袋！抱紧——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 快看～！雪人小野乃！很大吧～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小野乃圣诞老人来给大家送笑容啦～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 梦限大板羽球王争夺战，开幕～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 把小野乃的心意，倾注到巧克力里～！
